scripts.build: npm run build -w @vaenyx/contracts && npm run build -w @vaenyx/server && npm run build -w @vaenyx/web
scripts.check: npm run check:naming && npm run check:architecture && npm run check:translations && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @vaenyx/contracts && concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @vaenyx/server" "npm run dev -w @vaenyx/web"
scripts.release:check: npm run licenses && npm run check && npm run test:production && npm run test:ops
scripts.test: npm run build -w @vaenyx/contracts && npm run test -w @vaenyx/contracts && npm run test -w @vaenyx/server && npm run test -w @vaenyx/web
scripts.test:ops: node scripts/ops-smoke.mjs && node scripts/update-transaction-smoke.mjs && node scripts/version-policy-smoke.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @vaenyx/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @vaenyx/server && npm run typecheck -w @vaenyx/web
